inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver was observed allowing a child to lay down after toileting in a potty chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Potty-Chairs: A potty chair had not been emptied and sanitized after use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Potty-Chairs (26 TAC §746.3407(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Children were observed napping without a caregiver supervising.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver was observed stepping out of a back classroom and coming down the hallway to the front rooms while some children were still in the back classroom. Part of the class was in the front rooms while part of the class was still in the back classroom. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver gathered all the children she was supervising together.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A ziploc bag of pills was observed on a counter accessible to children. This was corrected at inspection when the bag was moved out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent inspection form was not posted. This was corrected at inspection when the director posted the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Out of four caregiver files reviewed, one caregiver did not have proof of pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Out of 4 children records reviewed, one child's record did not have the address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: The director did not have time cards to show they are present 75% of the operation hours or 30 hours per week. This is the third inspection the director was not present until after the inspection began. This was corrected when the director arrived an hour after the inspection began.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: During the inspection, the person in charge did not have access to the records needed to be reviewed during the inspection. The director arrived an hour after the inspection began to provide the access to the records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: During a follow up inspection, one caregiver did not have documentation of pre-service or trainings. All other items from this standard previously cited were observed during the inspection.     Original citation: Out of four personnel files reviewed: four were missing date of hire, four were missing documentation they received operational and personal policies, four were missing documentation they received orientation, one was missing a notarized affdavit and a pre-affidavit, two did not have their proof of education translated, and three did not have documentation of pre-service or trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was present without receiving a background check eligibility letter. This was corrected when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: During a follow up inspection, one staff file did not have peditric first aid or cpr. All other items from this standard previously cited were observed during the inspection.     Original citation: Out of four staff records reviewed, it was found that four staff do not have peditric first aid or cpr. One of the staff members had proof of an expired pediatric first aid and cpr with a current first aid course that does not include pediatric. Two of these caregivers were caring for children during inspection in rooms with ratios of one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Information obtained through the investigation shows that a child was left unsupervised for approximately 1-2 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Information obtained through the investigation shows that the operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation when a child was left unsupervised for approximately 1-2 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Information obtained through the investigation shows that the operation failed to provide an incident report to the parent within the required time frame when their child was left unsupervised for approximately 1-2 minutes.     The operation provided the parent an incident report over a week later after they were instructed to do so by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Out of four staff records reviewed, it was found that four staff do not have peditric first aid or cpr. One of the staff members had proof of an expired pediatric first aid and cpr with a current first aid course that does not include pediatric. Two of these caregivers were caring for children during inspection in rooms with ratios of one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Out of four personnel files reviewed: four were missing date of hire, four were missing documentation they received operational and personal policies, four were missing documentation they received orientation, one was missing a notarized affdavit and a pre-affidavit, two did not have their proof of education translated, and three did not have documentation of pre-service or trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation is not conducting emergency drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: One of the exits in the outdoor space was observed to be blocked by a play structure. This was corrected at inspection when the director moved the play structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Out of four children records reviewed, four children were missing date of enrollment, two children were missing health statements, three children were missing doctor information, one child had an affidavit that was not notarized and not the original copy, and one child had a vaccination record that did not have their name on it to verify it was their record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection a caregiver walked out of the room leaving a child unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
